subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Challenged'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3 is:** 'Challenged'**
 
• **In the context **of this sentence, the Titans, including Atlas, are opposing the gods of Mount Olympus.
 
• The most suitable word that describes this opposition or confrontation is **"challenged."**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'In 700 BCE Greek post Hesiod wrote “Theogony” and “Work and Days”. In these mythologies, Atlas was a Titan of enormous strength. He along with other titans **challenged **the gods of Mount Olympus. While the other Titans were banished to Tartarus after being defeated by the god Zeus as retribution, Atlas (4) _______ was forced to carry the earth and the sky for an eternity. In depictions of Atlas. obviously carved by human based on myths, he is shown as a stooped figure carrying the (5) _____ on his shoulders. Because of his association with the globe. maps began to be decorated with this image of Atlas. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's briefly look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Collaborated" **implies working together, which doesn't fit here because the Titans and the gods of Mount Olympus were not on the same side.
 
• **"Claimed" **is used when asserting or stating something, often without providing evidence or proof. This isn't appropriate in this context as the Titans were not asserting anything; they were opposing the gods.
 
• **"Corroborated"** means to confirm or give support to (a statement, theory, or finding), which also does not fit the context as the Titans were not supporting or confirming anything related to the gods.
